create_memory_tracker: create a MemoryTracker instance to monitor GPU memory usage during a training iteration
run_memory_monitoring: run memory monitoring on a PyTorch model by calling start_monitor, forward pass, backward pass, and stop
test_memory_tracker_stop: test the MemoryTracker.stop method to halt GPU memory tracking after a training iteration
summarize_memory_tracker: summarize the MemoryTracker memory stats summary by calling the summary method after monitoring
review_memory_traces: review the MemoryTracker operator-level memory traces by calling the show_traces method
